name: larks_head_knot
title: Lark's head knot
about: Mounts a cord on a holding cord, a rod or a ring: its two legs go up over the holding cord, round behind it and out under their own bar, which lies in front. Shown loose, from the front, tied with one end.

steps.caption: Bring the working cord up in front of the holding cord, over it, and back down behind it.
Take it across to the right, in front of its own first leg: this is the bar.
Take it up behind the holding cord, over it and down in front, then under the bar. Pull both legs down: the bar tightens over them.
